caption:
Before you speak or post tonight, remember this

The Prophet ﷺ said that whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should say something good, or else remain silent. Let every word pass that test.

Sunan Ibn Majah 3971 · Grade: Sahih

Send this to the friend who always picks kind words

#goodspeech #guardyourtongue #muslimmanners #hadithreels
alt_text: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him say something good, or else remain silent.” (Sunan Ibn Majah 3971)
